answer: Each agent ID enters through one inlet: a vouch from an agent with 50 paid jobs, and each vouch spends 20% of the voucher's reputation. Vouched IDs face spot audits drawn from the basalt pool, a hidden set of graded tasks. A failed audit sends a ripple back that halves the voucher's score. Fresh fakes have no reputation to spend, so a farm cannot vouch for itself. One account backs two IDs per epoch, so fifty fakes need twenty-five separately earned track records.
